questions.q: What term describes technologies that improve existing products?
questions.why: The book defines sustaining technologies as enhancing performance of existing products.

questions.q: According to Christensen, which factor is NOT one of the three rigid elements in large firms?
questions.why: Resources, processes, and values are listed; marketing budget is not.

questions.q: Why can startups overtake incumbents in disruptive markets?
questions.why: Startups succeed by serving low‑margin niche markets that incumbents ignore.

questions.q: What solution does Christensen propose for established firms facing disruption?
a: Create or acquire an independent subsidiary
questions.why: He suggests founding or acquiring a subsidiary with appropriate values and processes.

questions.q: Which famous entrepreneur said the book deeply influenced him?
questions.why: Steve Jobs mentioned the book's impact in his biography.
